findings.title: base-sync and human tests diagnosed but not made cheaper
findings.detail:
story.md Wanted: 'Look at why base-sync (71 s) and human (48 s) are slow ... and make them cheaper without losing what they pin.' The handoff explains the cause (~18 git spawns per tick at ~15 ms each) and defers the fix as a production change that rewrites the transcripts. The 'look at' half is met; the 'make cheaper' half is not. Slice checks no longer run these files, so the issue's main pain (#82 title) is solved.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Person files a follow-up issue to cut git calls per tick (rev-parse --verify, cat-file blob, rev-parse --git-path) with a transcript update.

findings.title: Test name claims 'exactly the folder' but compares two hardcoded values
findings.detail:
The test checks cliDir == 'packages/cli/test' and ignored == 'packages/cli' separately; it does not derive one from the other. Since tests may only live in packages/<pkg>/test (enforced elsewhere in repo.test.ts), ignoring packages/cli is equivalent in practice.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: reword the name, or assert cliDir.startsWith(ignored + '/').
